display_name: AufenthV § 26 and Anlage C, the airport transit visa: a law layer, a seat for the person changing planes, and the Art. 80(1) sentence 3 citation test
seat: a person changing planes at a German airport, asking whether they must hold an airport transit visa and whether they are exempt from needing a residence title while they wait in the international transit area.
edition: AufenthV § 26 and Anlage C, AufenthG § 99, Grundgesetz Art. 80, as printed on gesetze-im-internet.de on 2026-11-02; BGBl. 2015 I Nr. 54, 2023 I Nr. 201 and 2026 I Nr. 161 (gazette text and PDF); Visa Code Art. 3 and Annex IV, consolidated 28.06.2024 (excerpt checked against the saved EUR-Lex page); BVerfG 2 BvF 3/90 paras. 151 to 158 (../../registers/source-bundle/).
not_reviewed: No domain expert has read this encoding against the text. The consolidated texts are the site's reading versions, not the gazette; the Visa Code consolidation has no legal effect and may have been amended after 28.06.2024. The tests' expected values were written by the encoder from the text, not by an independent author.

check_sh_output: target: main. Each module is run with your l4 and with the main build below; the main columns must match.
module                                    errors satisfied  failed  refused  expected | errors satisfied  failed  refused  main

(target main: every module has the same four counts on the main build. That rules out a module main rejects and a difference an assertion shows; it does not see a different TRACE outcome, or any difference no assertion exercises)

scope.intent: AufenthV § 26 and Anlage C; AufenthG § 99(3a) as the power needed; Visa Code Art. 3 and Annex IV; Grundgesetz Art. 80(1) sentence 3 as the citation test. Not the rest of the Residence Regulation, the rest of § 99, or the rest of the Visa Code.
